reference: English Vocabulary Profile A1 (food and drink); Cambridge A1 Movers-style picture/gap items
matching: Items 1-2 gap-fill naming a food/drink from a short context clue; 3-4 three-option choice (one countable/uncountable distractor); EC = plural_s error on a countable food noun or wrong lexical choice ('drink' for 'eat') typical of Arabic L1; FP = sentence naming a food or drink you like; transfer = complete a cafe order line. All target words EVP A1 high-frequency, prompts 8-14 words. Item order identical across forms: 1-2 controlled gap-fill, 3-4 controlled choice, 5-6 error correction, 7-8 free production (target_form_0_1_2), 9 transfer. Review round 1: slot 5 is now a food-word sound confusion (kitchen/chicken, soap/soup, peeper/pepper); slot 6 eat/drink uses solid foods only. Re-review round 2: slot 6 uses soft food eaten with a spoon (soup, yoghurt, ice cream), where Arabic-L1 learners transfer shariba; "with a spoon" makes eat the only standard verb. Review round 3: C-6 ice cream replaced by lentil soup (Arabic eats ice cream; soup/yoghurt are the real drink-for-eat transfer), parallel to A-6/B-6.
